method: Exact full excerpt relocation and mapped node span comparison; historical census; CP287 canonical row/node/scope crosswalk; CP292 complement checked; exact equality with CP300 remaining owner row IDs. Local source contracts, not full current AST replay.

groups.title: S identity and A handoff
groups.meaning: Map input items in encounter order; no filter/sort/dedup. Native direction, color, formation type and A ordinal/index retained. A source, stop and stop event timestamps converted separately with epoch; A price converted to string without rounding.

groups.title: S order identity and chronology
groups.meaning: Preserve direction, reaction number, mode, first and break indices as supplied, nullable. First, break and confirmation timestamps independently converted only when not None; absence is null, not a fallback to main time.

groups.title: S box geometry
groups.meaning: Box top/bottom converted to string only when non-null; source indices retained directly and source timestamps independently nullable. Zero Decimal not treated as absent.

groups.title: S stop and reset provenance
groups.meaning: Order stop level nullable string; source index unchanged, source time nullable epoch. Reset reaction number unchanged and reset time independently nullable; no reconstruction of missing order or reset.

groups.title: S public decision
groups.meaning: Source and decision indices retained; source and decision/main and exact event epochs independently emitted; price string; calculationValid literal true, not recomputed. All fields map native selected records.

groups.title: E identity and parent
groups.meaning: Map records in input order. Preserve direction, family, number, parent type/source/stop indices; parent price string; parent source, main stop and exact stop event epochs required, no local fallback.

groups.title: E order causes
groups.meaning: Preserve direction/reaction number/mode; construct list from native order_causes preserving iteration order and duplicates; parent-stop cause time is independently nullable; no priority logic.

groups.title: E order geometry
groups.meaning: First/break indices and epochs, confirmation epoch, box top/bottom prices and source identities/times, stop level/source identity/time are required by native schema. Price string, timestamps epoch, no optional guards on these conversions.

groups.title: E public decision
groups.meaning: Source index/time and price string, decision index/time/event epoch; no calculationValid field in this serializer. No mutation, selection, sorting, lifecycle or numbering recomputation.

groups.title: StopAll native identity and gate
groups.meaning: Keep direction/number/source and decision indices; convert source, decision, decision event and gate event times independently. Price string. Gate type and stopped behavior type/key/count are preserved, not inferred from donor. Underlying E family/number may be null.

groups.title: StopAll order causes and timing
groups.meaning: Keep optional order direction/reaction number/mode/indices; convert causes iterable to list in order, no dedup. Parent-stop cause, first/break/confirmation times independently nullable by explicit None guard.

groups.title: StopAll box and stop geometry
groups.meaning: Optional box top/bottom and order stop level string only when not None, preserving zero; source indices unchanged; source times independently nullable. Native geometry not recomputed.

groups.title: StopAll termination
groups.meaning: Stop index unchanged; stop and exact event timestamps use truthiness rather than explicit None. Absent/falsy timestamps output null, otherwise epoch. Legacy schema omits donor provenance and calculationValid; order preserved, no sorting or mutation.

groups.title: Bridge datetime type gates
groups.meaning: None returns null, string returned unchanged (including empty/invalid strings); other non-datetime values return null. No parsing or coercion.

groups.title: Bridge datetime formatting
groups.meaning: Format supplied datetime component fields year/month/day/hour/minute/second with fixed zero-padded date-time pattern. No timezone conversion, offset or microseconds in output; native Tehran-local convention expected.

groups.title: Bridge direction label
groups.meaning: Apply str then title case without validating bullish/bearish; noncanonical input is not rejected locally.

groups.title: Bridge mode mapping
groups.meaning: Convert mode to string and look up exact case-sensitive A→Leg Start or B→Normal; all other keys yield null; no fallback or case normalization.

groups.title: Bridge color label
groups.meaning: Membership in (None, empty string) gives null; otherwise str then title case; no whitelist or direction-based inversion.

groups.title: Bridge horizon
groups.meaning: Use timestamp of market.candles[end_index] plus chronology.timeframe, the exclusive end of final visible main candle. No clamp, minus-one, or lower-history bound; index/attribute/type errors propagate.

groups.title: Bridge horizon gate
groups.meaning: Return false for None without computing horizon; otherwise strict value < horizon. Equality rejected, no lower-bound check or time normalization. Comparison/index exceptions propagate.
